symptom: i2cdetect -y 1 shows an empty grid — no devices at all. My BME280 is on the bus and was working yesterday. Nothing I change in code helps.

gold.diagnosis: An empty i2cdetect grid with a device attached means SDA and/or SCL is disconnected (or VCC to the sensor is missing), or the pull-ups are absent. The kernel sees no ACK from any address. This is a wiring fault; STOP coding and check the SDA/SCL/VCC/GND connections and the pull-up resistors.
